_comment: Hearth and Harvest blocks removed 2026-11-14 (plan_bugfix_1114 3.1, 3.2). Hops on a lattice were their own block, hearthandharvest:hops (the hops ITEM keeps that id, so only the block registry remaps): it loads as Vinery's grapevine_lattice with its age and facing; the lattice turns its grape back to hops on the first random tick or use (LegacyLatticeStemBlock.restoreHops). H&H tilled end stone loads as Ender Crop's. Never prune.
